answer: Each identity must own one vineyard estate, entered in the appellation registry; one estate backs one identity, a second claim is rejected. A yarrow border marks the boundary; each season the inspector checks the copper spray log and harvest tally, then quill-signs it. Entry: 2,500 units plus 400 in fees; first vintage takes 1,095 days, and no payment ripens vines faster. 100 fakes: 290,000 units, 100 estates, 300 vineyard-years. Cheapest cheat is renting one for 1,800 units a season, but the lender loses its own anchor and income, and a forged certificate fails the seal check.
